% ADDED figure (2026-11-02): the diagrams of one example box (C6a/C6b/§CA.7); generated by qft-C/tools/c6diag/figs/make_figs.sh
\tikzset{
  fdl/.style={line width=0.8pt, black},
  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
  \tikzset{src/.style={cross out, draw=figB, line width=1.1pt, minimum size=7pt, inner sep=0pt}}
  % (a) m = 1
  \begin{scope}
    \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(1.6,0);
    \node[src] at (0,0){}; \node[src] at (1.6,0){};
    \node[fdlab,above] at (0,0.1){$x_1$}; \node[fdlab,above] at (1.6,0.1){$x_2$};
    \node[fdS] at (0.8,-1.05) {$D_F(x_1-x_2)$};
    \node[fdS] at (0.8,-1.75) {(a) $m=1$: $G^{(2)}$, one pairing; integral $J$};
  \end{scope}
  % (b) m = 2, three pairings
  \begin{scope}[xshift=5.9cm]
    \foreach \dx/\pr/\lab in {0/12/{D_{12}D_{34}}, 2.9/13/{D_{13}D_{24}}, 5.8/14/{D_{14}D_{23}}}{
      \begin{scope}[xshift=\dx cm]
        \coordinate (P1) at (0,0.55); \coordinate (P2) at (1.3,0.55); \coordinate (P3) at (0,-0.55); \coordinate (P4) at (1.3,-0.55);
        \ifnum\pr=12 \draw[fdl] (P1)--(P2); \draw[fdl] (P3)--(P4); \fi
        \ifnum\pr=13 \draw[fdl] (P1)--(P3); \draw[fdl] (P2)--(P4); \fi
        \ifnum\pr=14 \draw[fdl] (P1)--(P4); \draw[fdl] (P2)--(P3); \fi
        \foreach \q in {P1,P2,P3,P4} \node[src] at (\q){};
        \node[fdlab,left] at ($(P1)+(-0.16,0)$){$x_1$}; \node[fdlab,right] at ($(P2)+(0.16,0)$){$x_2$};
        \node[fdlab,left] at ($(P3)+(-0.16,0)$){$x_3$}; \node[fdlab,right] at ($(P4)+(0.16,0)$){$x_4$};
        \node[fdS] at (0.65,-1.05) {$\lab$};
      \end{scope}
    }
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (3.55,-1.75) {(b) $m=2$: $G^{(4)}$, the $3=\frac{4!}{2^2\,2!}$ pairings; each integrates to $J^2$};
  \end{scope}
  \node[fdS,align=center] at (6.0,-2.6) {$D_{ij}=D_F(x_i-x_j)$; each $\times$ is a source point $i j(x_l)\,d^4x_l$;\quad $Z[j]=\sum_m\frac{(-1)^m}{(2m)!}\cdot\frac{(2m)!}{2^m m!}\,J^m=e^{-J/2}$,\quad $J=\int d^4x\,d^4y\,j(x)D_F(x-y)j(y)$};
\end{tikzpicture}
